goal: Generate a fashion magazine-style vertical cover in 4:5 or 3:4 format, with the main title in Chinese, decorative text in English, and the main visual as a full-body or knee-up shot.

main_visual.description: A fictional female subject around 30 years old with long golden-brown curly hair (oval face shape, light olive skin tone, gray-blue eyes), knee-length, wearing a light champagne satin dress, long curls hanging loosely to one side, hand gently lifting the dress hem, gaze slightly narrative toward outside the frame, background is seamless warm gray photo shoot, with a light reflection on the ground
main_visual.composition: Character slightly to the left, with the right third reserved for vertically arranged large title and magazine name, leaving space above the head.

title_block.main_title_style: Vertical high-contrast serif, slightly loose letter spacing, positioned beside the character's right shoulder either bottom-up or top-down depending on composition, lower opacity by 15% when partially overlapping with sheer fabric

items: Famous talk show host discussing generational trauma and healing
Spring Wear: Sixteen Translations from Runway to Urban Streets
Five authors repeatedly appearing in the White House reading list
Beauty: New formula ideology for skin nourishment with oil this season
side_teasers.position: Left side narrow column with small text, or two columns of English guide at the bottom

color_palette: Off-white sky + warm gold title + character skin tone naturally leaning pink

barcode.position: Lower left corner or lower right corner not pressing the character's toes

must_keep: The main title has sufficient contrast with the edges of the character's clothing.
The Chinese guide for the entire issue has no typos, and the English is at title-level phrases, not long paragraphs
Overall white space is ≥ 15%, giving a sense of breathing consistent with luxury quality.
avoid: Multiple brand cosmetics collage corner label
Verbatim or page-by-page replication of a specific issue of VOGUE
Identifiable urban geographic landmarks appear in the background
Deliberately close to the portrait details of any specific real public figure
